history.v1_v2_scope: per-unit/per-cluster evaluator and exact session-bound repair remain preserved evidence
history.planner_amendment: global duplicate-event credit across clusters; practical loss margins; held-out and selection-aware best-arm reporting; no ten-unit floor; inconclusive is not equivalence

milestone: Make K10 decision-safe before K9 or any real joint-model arm output is inspected.
decision_changed: Whether saved arm outputs can be scored without reusing truth/output events across clusters or turning selected-development uncertainty into an equivalence claim.
input_domain: synthetic saved arrays and synthetic arm summaries only; no recording, voltage, sorter, DARTsort, K9 or real arm output

matching_unchanged.algorithm: deterministic maximum-cardinality bipartite matching over inclusive +/-15 sample and required per-event placement gates

global_event_credit.all_truth_all_output: one deterministic maximum-cardinality match over every truth event and every output event; each row can receive at most one global credit
global_event_credit.per_unit_across_clusters: one pooled-output match for each truth unit
global_event_credit.cross_cluster_duplicate_credit_count: sum of that unit's independent per-cluster TP minus its pooled-output TP
global_event_credit.cross_unit_competing_credit_count: sum of per-unit pooled-output TP minus all-truth/all-output global TP
global_event_credit.gross_pairwise_tp: sum over all truth-unit/output-cluster comparisons, reported but never interpreted as recovered event count
global_event_credit.receipts: global matched truth/output row indices, credited counts by truth unit and output cluster, unique recall, and both duplicate/competition counts

selection_aware_arm_report.development_only_selection: select one candidate arm using one named development primary endpoint and frozen direction; deterministic arm-name tie break
selection_aware_arm_report.holdout_input: exactly one selected-arm-versus-baseline summary; non-selected candidate holdout summaries are rejected
selection_aware_arm_report.n_units: any positive integer is reported; there is no ten-unit floor and small support is not hidden
selection_aware_arm_report.overall: FAIL if any required endpoint fails; PASS only if all pass; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
selection_aware_arm_report.interpretation: PASS is one-sided non-inferiority within frozen practical loss margins, not equivalence or superiority; INCONCLUSIVE is never counted as a tie or equivalence

acceptance: global matcher agrees with an independent brute-force oracle and never credits a truth or output row twice
a duplicated spike split across clusters has two gross per-cluster TP but one global event credit and one cross-cluster duplicate credit
split/merge/many-to-one and chance-null outputs remain unchanged
development selection cannot read holdout values and holdout arm identity must equal the selected arm
higher/lower endpoint margin boundaries and all PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE combinations pass known answers
n_units 1 is accepted and reported; n_units 0/noninteger fails closed
no result overwrite and all previous exact-clock guards remain green
frozen implementation receives focused independent review before any real arm output
exclusions: no K9 or real arm output inspection
no sorter, GPU, RF, holdout dataset, motion re-estimation, package change, C4 edit or service

scope.can_establish: synthetic arithmetic, global credit and selection-aware decision plumbing
scope.cannot_establish: benchmark validity, arm benefit, equivalence, superiority, biological identity/purity, power, or medium/full-run readiness
